description: Authorizes customer refunds after validating refund eligibility, approval, fraud assessment, and refund amount limits.

unboundSignalReasons.refundEligible: Result of an independent eligibility check against the customer/order record; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.managerApproved: Attested by a separate human-approval step; the Intent carries no approval-status field to bind against.
unboundSignalReasons.fraudCheckPassed: Result of an independent fraud-assessment system; not something the Intent's target/parameters could express.

outcome.reason: Refund authorized. Eligibility, approval, fraud assessment, and refund amount requirements were satisfied.
Refund rejected because the requested refund amount exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Refund rejected because the transaction did not pass fraud assessment.
Refund rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
